g.text: The shared digital work-and-payment ledger. What both acknowledge becomes the official truth.
दो फोन · एक साझा हिसाब · अगस्त 2026
Both confirmed · Sharma Ji ✓ & Sunita Didi ✓
School fee assistance · Digital receipt acknowledged
झाड़ू, पोंछा, बर्तन एवं दोनों समय का खाना · मालिक द्वारा दर्ज
* Recorded by employer. Holds ₹0.00 until Sunita confirms.
क्या 13 अगस्त का यह काम सही है?
* Today's ₹500 is pending confirmation. Tap "Sahi Hai" to include it in the hisaab.
जो दोनों मानें, वही हिसाब — न एक रुपया कम, न एक रुपया ज्यादा।
Two separate memories will always create two contradictory balances.
"अकेला हिसाब हर महीने की आखिरी तारीख को संकोच और बहस में बदल जाता है।"
A pencil tick mark on the kitchen calendar cannot distinguish a full day from a half day or a substitute helper. When dates get blurred, memory becomes an uncomfortable argument.
"Did she come in the morning or evening?"
₹1,000 cash given in a hurry at the doorway during morning rush. No paper slip. No timestamp. By the 31st, one remembers ₹1,000; the other remembers ₹500.
"Was it for school fees or festival bonus?"
Every day's work and every rupee of advance is acknowledged tonight on mobile. Only entries confirmed by both sides exist in the shared hisaab.
प्रविष्टि का सफर: दर्ज होना, परखा जाना और दोनों की सहमति से पक्का होना।
Sharma Ji logs today’s attendance. Under SevaKhata’s mutual rule, this entry is held in strict quarantine. It holds ₹0.00 financial gravity and cannot alter what is owed until acknowledged.
"जब तक सुनीता दीदी 'सही है' नहीं दबाएंगी, यह रकम हिसाब में नहीं जुड़ेगी।"
The first of the month in complete peace.
"कमाई, पेसगी और पक्का बकाया — सब दोनों की आँखों के सामने स्पष्ट।"
READY FOR MONTH-END PAYOUT · MUTUALLY CONFIRMED
Household work is real work. It deserves the mutual dignity of a shared, transparent digital record.
Two phones. One record. Complete mutual peace.
Dono ka record, ek hi hisaab · The shared domestic employment ledger.
